KeyPassages: Genesis 4:21; 1 Samuel 10:5; 2 Samuel 6:5; 1 Kings 10:12; 1 Chronicles 13:8; 2 Chronicles 5:12
BiblicalUsage: Kinnor is the harp. Genesis 4:21 names Jubal as the father of all such as handle the harp and organ, 1 Samuel 10:5 has prophets coming down with harp before them, and 2 Samuel 6:5 and 1 Chronicles 13:8 have David and all Israel playing before the LORD on harps. 1 Kings 10:12 says Solomon made harps of almug trees for the house of the LORD, and 2 Chronicles 5:12 sets the Levite singers with harps at the east end of the altar.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the harp runs from Jubal to the temple because music was never decoration in Israel: it was how the people played before the LORD. I hold that David's harp and the Levites' harps say the same thing, that worship is something you do with your hands, not only with your mouth.
